description.value: One ideal value, finite ordered sequence with duplicates allowed, finite exact string-key mapping with unique keys, or no assertion. Unknown labels remain uninterpreted.
UMF role; unknown labels remain uninterpreted. Missing is unspecified, never inferred from scalarType.
Ideal value availability. Unknown labels remain uninterpreted. Missing and unspecified assert no availability constraint. Native absence carriers require explicit bindings.
Missing members impose no bound. Unknown members and qualifiers are retained without interpretation.
Signed [-2^(bits-1),2^(bits-1)-1] or unsigned [0,2^bits-1]; mathematical domain, not a physical storage-width assertion.
Known units: unicode-scalar for string, byte for binary. Unknown units remain uninterpreted.
Decimal coefficient digit bound; requires scale. Absolute coefficient is less than 10^precision. No implicit rounding.
Fixed fractional digit count; requires precision. Semantic validation requires scale <= precision. Value equals integer coefficient times 10^-scale.
Basic value families; native refinements remain authoritative for ranges, precision, encoding and temporal behavior.
Unknown family retained with incomplete semantic validation.
